fiji.permits: Most reef breaks are reached by paid boat transfers from a resort or village (older price lists show about FJ$50 to 70 a person for a day); a 2025 bill would hand control of surf areas back to the traditional owners, so check the current rules

costa-rica.permits: Witch's Rock and Ollie's Point are inside Santa Rosa National Park, so a park entry fee (about $15 to 17 a person) and a licensed boat operator are needed; most surfers book a boat tour

bali.permits: Padang Padang charges a small beach entrance fee (roughly IDR 10,000 to 30,000, plus parking)

sydney.permits: Boards are not allowed inside the flagged swimming area at patrolled beaches, and Bondi has confined hard boards to its southern end; check Waverley Council for the current rules

bavaria-munich.permits: The Eisbach river wave was closed after a fatal accident in 2025; reports say the city allowed experienced surfers back in May 2026 under tighter rules, but its own page may still list it as closed, so check before going
